extraction_scope: Final mechanism ontology adjudication from primary source, replacing prior automated placeholder claims.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Designed ACE2-derived peptides antagonize the SARS-CoV-2 S-RBD:ACE2 interaction in a luciferase-based interaction assay.
mechanism_claims.direct_assay_type: luciferase-based NanoBiT S-RBD:ACE2 interaction inhibition assay

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=Synthetic Peptides Efficiently Block the Interaction of ACE2 with S-RBD; xml:table=1; xml:fig=5

mechanism_claims.limitations: This is not direct evidence of successful viral replication inhibition; Supplementary Table S5 reports infection blocking was not confirmed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: MST experiments show direct binding of peptides 1-6 to purified SARS-CoV-2 S-RBD with nanomolar Kd values.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=Synthetic Peptides Bind to Purified S-RBD with Nanomolar Affinity; xml:table=1; xml:fig=5

mechanism_claims.limitations: Binding supports target engagement but does not by itself establish cell-entry or replication inhibition.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SARS-CoV-2 infection inhibition in VERO-E6 cells was not confirmed for the peptides under the tested conditions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Records absence of confirmed infection blocking; not a potency endpoint.

superseded_placeholder_claims: automated nucleic-acid / immune-modulation locator notes were not source-supported mechanism claims for these peptides

ontology_cautions.detail: Primary source supports S-RBD binding and S-RBD:ACE2 interaction antagonism; infection blocking was not confirmed.
